title: Lakshyabhed
desc: Rupak and Joy, two brothers, live with their step-uncle and his wife, who conspire against them. Soon, the brothers strive hard to expose their relatives' actions.

title: Simul Parul
desc: Simul, Rajani's son, falls in love with Parul. However, Parul's father disapproves of their relationship because of his complicated history with Rajani.

title: Pabitra Papi
desc: To teach Bhola a lesson, Rajib marries his sister, deceives them out of their land, and has Bhola imprisoned. However, Bhola vows to seek justice and avenge the wrongs done to his family.

title: Barkane
desc: Sandip, an unemployed man, refuses a politician's offer to kill Tribeni, his rival. When Tribeni learns about this, she falls in love with him and offers dowry to his father.

title: Parineeta
desc: Childhood sweethearts Lalita and Shekhar wish to get married someday. However, Shekhar's growing suspicions about Lalita coupled with his conniving father's antics threaten to tear them apart.

title: Aagaman
desc: A dedicated farmer wages a fierce battle against a corrupt businessman to defend the rights of his community. He soon joins forces with his lawyer son to strengthen their legal fight.

title: Switzerland
desc: Shibu and Rumi lead a middle-class family life with their children and can only afford to go to local destinations for holidays. One day, they decide to save money for a trip to Switzerland.

title: Marshal
desc: THE DEATH OF RITESH'S BROTHER BRINGS A LOT OF TROUBLE TO THE FAMILY. WHEN A MYSTERIOUS MAN, MARSHAL, SOLVES ALL THEIR ISSUES, RITESH INVITES HIM TO STAY WITH THEM IN THEIR HOUSE.

title: Patanjali Yog
desc: A yoga guru teaches a wide range of body postures and breathing exercises to enable viewers to achieve physical, mental, and spiritual well-being.

title: Joy Kali Kalkattawali
desc: A priceless idol of Goddess Kali vanishes from a temple near Kolkata. Diverse factions, including the police, embark on a quest to retrieve the revered deity statue, seeking its rightful return.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Bengali artists love devotional and folk songs. These songs inspire singers and audiences alike. They celebrate culture and faith, creating a shared experience.
